title: 九局下半 · 占位样片
notes: 时间线是共享状态机：state_delta 按镜头顺序演化，形成每个镜头的连续性快照。所有 provider 都从同一份快照编译，不允许各自维护角色状态。

scenes.label: 休息区 · 黄昏
scenes.lighting_en: low warm sunset raking across the dugout, long shadows, dust in the air, deep blue ambient shadows
scenes.composition_en: dugout roof frames the character on the left third, empty field receding behind

scenes.label: 打击区 · 黄昏
scenes.location_en: worn dirt batter's box in an old high-school baseball field
scenes.lighting_en: golden-hour backlight from the outfield, dust haze, rim light on the batter, deep blue sky
scenes.composition_en: batter's box centered, diamond receding into dust haze, low horizon

shots.action_en: Lin Ye sits alone on the dugout bench, gripping his wooden bat with both hands, eyes fixed on the scoreboard off-screen.
shots.action_zh: 林野独自坐在休息区长椅上，双手握着球棒，盯着画外的记分牌。

continuity.notes: 开场：干净主场球衣、球棒、黄昏光。

shots.notes: 建立镜头：先让观众记住脸、球衣号码 7 和球棒。

shots.action_en: Lin Ye rises from the bench, dust and infield dirt smearing his white jersey as he grabs his bat, jaw set.
shots.action_zh: 林野从长椅起身，尘土和场上的泥蹭脏了白色球衣，他抓起球棒，咬紧牙关。

continuity.notes: 球衣从干净变为泥污；球棒继续持有。

shots.notes: 第一次状态变化：泥污从这里开始，后续镜头不能重置。

shots.action_en: Lin Ye walks from the dugout toward the batter's box, bat loose in his right hand, dusty jersey catching the backlight, crowd blurred at the edge of frame.
shots.action_zh: 林野从休息区走向打击区，球棒松握在右手，沾泥的球衣被逆光勾边，观众在画面边缘虚化。

continuity.notes: 泥污延续；场景从休息区切到打击区，光线保持同一黄昏。

shots.notes: 空间转换镜头：必须保持球衣泥污与球棒。

shots.action_en: Close on Lin Ye's face as he touches his bruised left cheek with a gloved hand, breathes through the pain, then looks up at the pitcher.
shots.action_zh: 特写：林野用戴手套的手碰了碰左脸淤青，忍痛呼吸，然后抬眼看向投手。

continuity.notes: 新增伤情：左脸淤青、下唇破口；右袖撕裂；球棒仍在手中。

shots.notes: 高风险特写：伤情从这里开始，下一镜必须延续。

shots.action_en: Lin Ye stands alone in the batter's box and raises the bat against the sunset, torn sleeve and bruised face visible, dust drifting across the empty diamond.
shots.action_zh: 林野独自站在打击区，在夕阳里举起球棒，撕裂的袖口和淤青的脸清晰可见，尘土掠过空荡的内野。

continuity.notes: 伤情、撕裂球衣、球棒全部延续；黄昏光保持一致。

shots.notes: 收尾镜头：同一套角色状态，不做无解释重置。
